title: Personal Workflow Audit
description: CAT 100 textbook section on personal workflow audit, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Rank tasks by weekly cost (frequency times duration) to identify the true highest-cost target rather than the task that feels worst.
Convert a felt improvement into a measured one using a before/after baseline of time and error rate.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it.
